facts.fact: The Council of Europe cybercrime office's legal profile, version of 5 May 2020, maps Eritrea's Penal Code (Art. 374 unauthorized use of a computer, covering access, interception, data and system interference, and Art. 298 violation of privacy) to the Budapest Convention's offence articles as its domestic equivalent, and lists Eritrea as not a signatory; it gives no separate cybercrime act.
